observation_summary: The code attempts to access a character at 'text.length()' inside a while loop, causing a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. The loop condition 'pos <= text.length()' is incorrect for character access.
hypothesis: The StringIndexOutOfBoundsException occurs because the while loop condition 'pos <= text.length()' in findWrapPos allows 'pos' to reach 'text.length()', which is an invalid index for 'text.charAt(pos)'. The logic should use 'pos < text.length()' to ensure the index is always within bounds.
prediction: Changing the condition from 'pos <= text.length()' to 'pos < text.length()' will prevent the StringIndexOutOfBoundsException and allow the method to correctly identify the wrap position or return -1 when no valid wrap point is found.
